title: Neural Spectral Capacity with Residual Context for Heterogeneous Resource Allocation within Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2610.30823v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Predicting relative trained performance from architectural specifications can guide design when training costs limit experimentation. Neural Spectral Capacity (NSC) provides such a heuristic, but scores projections independently and assigns identical scores to compatible reorderings of the same layer configurations. We introduce Residual-Aware Neural Spectral Capacity (ResNSC) for Transformers, using a specification-derived statistical reference for accumulated residual updates to determine the input and residual-state statistics in each projection's capacity calculation, while retaining additive evaluation without data or instantiated weights. When residual widths vary, earlier choices affect later scores, so we augment NSC's allocator (NSC-DP) with residual history beyond its layer-and-budget state. translated_title: 面向Transformer内部异构资源分配的带残差上下文的神经谱容量
translated_abstract: 当训练成本限制了实验次数时，从架构规格预测相对训练后性能可以为设计提供指导。神经谱容量提供了一种这样的启发式方法，但它独立地对各投影进行评分，并且对同一层配置的兼容重排序赋予相同的分数。我们为Transformer引入了残差感知神经谱容量，使用从规格推导的累积残差更新统计参考，来确定每个投影容量计算中的输入和残差状态统计量，同时保持无需数据或实例化权重的可加评估特性。当残差宽度变化时，较早的选择会影响后续的评分，因此我们在NSC的分配器（NSC-DP）基础上增加了超出其层-预算状态的残差历史信息。ResNSC-DP在资源预算约束下联合分配残差宽度和前馈宽度，并对最佳数值可评估的候选架构提供了认证边界。
tldr: 本文提出残差感知神经谱容量ResNSC及其动态规划分配器ResNSC-DP，通过在容量计算中引入残差历史统计信息，在无需数据或实例化权重的情况下，解决了原NSC方法独立评分、无法区分层配置重排序的问题，并能在资源预算下为Transformer联合分配残差和前馈宽度。
